dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What does this mean for the Guild's relations with the Akademiya?

dialogues.speaker: Yingzhu
dialogues.text: Incidents like this are everyone's worst nightmare. It's damaging for the Guild's reputation, and it will affect our standing with the Akademiya...

dialogues.speaker: Yingzhu
dialogues.text: *sigh* It's such a mess. We have to find some way of putting everything right...

dialogues.speaker: Yingzhu
dialogues.text: Traveler, please do make the matter of the Irminsul Fruit fragments and the Energy Amplifier your top priority.
